ContactFormSubmission.title: ContactFormSubmission
ContactFormSubmission.description: Represents a contact form submission from the website.

id.description: Unique identifier for the contact form submission.

name.description: Name of the person submitting the form.

email.description: Email address of the person submitting the form.

subject.description: Subject of the contact form submission.

message.description: The message content of the contact form submission.

submittedAt.description: Timestamp of when the form was submitted.

definition.description: Stores contact form submissions from the website. No denormalized authorization fields are needed since all submissions are publicly accessible for admin review.

params.name: contactFormSubmissionId
params.description: Unique identifier for the contact form submission.

firestore.reasoning:
This Firestore structure prioritizes security and scalability for the DukaanMitra public website, focusing on contact form submissions. It leverages structural segregation by placing contact form submissions in a dedicated collection with consistent security needs.

**Authorization Independence:** This design avoids hierarchical authorization dependencies by storing all necessary data within each document. Since all submissions are treated equally (no drafts or private submissions), this collection benefits from a homogeneous security posture. This means no `get()` calls are required in the security rules, ensuring atomic operations.

**QAPs (Rules Are Not Filters):** The design supports secure `list` operations because all documents in the `contactFormSubmissions` collection share the same access control requirements. Security rules can efficiently validate read access without needing to filter based on document content.
